---
title: "O3.3 Per-language IRT + stage 2 — exploratory"
format: html
params:
  stage2_variant: "linear"
  run_per_language_models: false
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(glue)
library(here)
library(brms)
library(cmdstanr)
library(tidyverse)

theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
bilingual_item_data_clean <- readRDS(here("data", "items.rds"))

f_instruments <- list.files(here("instruments"))
all_instruments <- map(f_instruments, \(f) {
  read_csv(here("instruments", f), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(uid = glue("item_{row_number()}")) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(category, definition, gloss, uni_lemma, uid),
      names_to = "form",
      values_to = "item_id"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      language = str_remove(f, ".csv"),
      uid = glue("{language}_{uid}")
    )
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  filter(!is.na(item_id)) |>
  mutate(form = case_when(
    form == "OxfordExtended" ~ "Oxford Extended",
    form == "OxfordShortII" ~ "Oxford Short II",
    form == "WSExtended" ~ "WS Extended",
    form == "WGShort" ~ "WG Short",
    .default = form
  ))

df_data <- bilingual_item_data_clean |>
  rename(unilemma = uni_lemma) |>
  filter(item_kind == "word", language != "Other Langs") |>
  left_join(
    all_instruments |> dplyr::select(language, form, item_id, uid),
    by = join_by(language, form, item_id)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    uid = coalesce(uid, glue("{language}_{item_id}")),
    value = as.numeric(produces),
    age_sc = scale(age)[, 1]
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(value))

language_eligible <- df_data |>
  group_by(language) |>
  summarise(n_admin = n_distinct(data_id), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_admin > 100) |>
  arrange(desc(n_admin))

language_eligible
```

Eligibility rule: **`n_distinct(data_id)` per `language` > 100** administrations (words-only `df_data` inclusion).

# Fit loop (stage 1 + stage 2)

```{r eval=params$run_per_language_models}
stage1_formula <- bf(
  value ~ exp(logalpha) * (theta + beta),
  theta ~ 0 + (1 | data_id),
  beta ~ 0 + (1 |i| uid),
  logalpha ~ 1 + (1 |i| uid),
  nl = TRUE
)

stage1_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", nlpar = "logalpha"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "sd", nlpar = "theta"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "sd", nlpar = "beta"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "sd", nlpar = "logalpha")
)

theta_from_stage1 <- function(mod) {
  theta_ranef <- ranef(mod, summary = TRUE)$data_id[, , "theta_Intercept"]
  theta_fixed <- 0
  tibble(
    data_id = rownames(theta_ranef),
    theta_est = theta_fixed + theta_ranef[, "Estimate"],
    theta_se = theta_ranef[, "Est.Error"]
  )
}

df_demogs <- readRDS(here("data", "demographics.rds"))

for (lang in language_eligible$language) {
  df_lang <- df_data |> filter(language == lang)
  safe <- str_replace_all(lang, "[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_")
  lang_base <- str_remove(lang, " \\(.*\\)$")

  message("Stage 1: ", lang)
  mod1 <- brm(
    formula = stage1_formula,
    data = df_lang,
    family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
    prior = stage1_priors,
    algorithm = "meanfield",
    iter = 10000,
    tol_rel_obj = 1e-4,
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    threads = threading(2),
    seed = 123
  )

  saveRDS(mod1, here("models", glue("stage1_language_{safe}.rds")))

  theta_estimates <- theta_from_stage1(mod1)

  child_lang <- df_demogs |>
    left_join(
      bilingual_item_data_clean |>
        dplyr::filter(language == lang) |>
        dplyr::select(data_id, language) |>
        distinct(),
      by = "data_id"
    ) |>
    mutate(age_sc = scale(age)[, 1]) |>
    dplyr::select(data_id, child_id, age_sc, dataset_name, language, age, languages) |>
    mutate(
      data_id = as.character(data_id),
      child_id = as.character(child_id)
    ) |>
    unnest(languages) |>
    filter(!is.na(exposure_language), !is.na(exposure_proportion)) |>
    dplyr::select(-age_first_exposed) |>
    filter(
      exposure_language == lang_base |
        (lang_base == "Mandarin" & exposure_language == "Chinese")
    ) |>
    mutate(exp_sc = scale(log1p(exposure_proportion / 100))[, 1]) |>
    left_join(theta_estimates, by = "data_id") |>
    filter(exposure_proportion <= 100)

  child_lang_clean <- child_lang |>
    filter(!is.na(theta_est), age >= 7) |>
    mutate(
      exposure_proportion = exposure_proportion / 100,
      exp_c = scale(exposure_proportion, scale = FALSE)[, 1],
      age_c = scale(age, scale = FALSE)[, 1]
    )

  message("Stage 2: ", lang)
  ## Single language: random effects over dataset (language is constant)
  fit2 <- brm(
    bf(theta_est | mi(theta_se) ~ age_c * exp_c + (1 | child_id) +
      (age_c * exp_c | dataset_name)),
    data = child_lang_clean,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = c(
      prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
      prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
      prior(exponential(1), class = sd)
    ),
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    chains = 4,
    iter = 2000,
    cores = 4,
    seed = 123
  )

  saveRDS(fit2, here("models", glue("stage2_language_{safe}.rds")))
}
```

Compare each `stage2_language_*.rds` fixed effects to the pooled stage-2 model for `params$stage2_variant`:

```{r}
pooled <- readRDS(here(
  "models",
  glue("bilingual_hirt_stage2_model_{params$stage2_variant}.rds")
))

fixef(pooled)
```
